and the three non-tank players will be marked for Digest. If Kamikiri spawns while Amikiri is casting Shuck, Digest instead targets the three players not targeted by Shuck. The attack leaves a water puddle under each target, which inflicts Dropsy as long as a player stands in it.

* Periodically the boss will summon two Shark adds, Naishi-no-jo and Naishi-no-Kami, which lock onto a specific player with a line AoE, Bite and Run which will do large amounts of damage will follow the targeted player. These should be killed ASAP, before they can execute their rush attack. The Naishi-no-jo is weaker, and will target a random DPS. The Naishi-no-Kami is stronger and targets the healer, but will take longer to complete its cast.

* Frost Breath: Two distinct attacks cast one after another. The first attack targets a non-tank and damages everything in a line from the boss to the targeted player. The second marks the tank and hits a wide arc in the tank's direction. Several ice puddles appear in the areas the attacks hit. The attack itself inflicts a dispellable frostbite Frostbite, while the puddles also inflict frostbite Frostbite for as long as a player stands in them.
* Torpedo: Moderate tank damage.

* Allagan Gravity: Targets a random player with a large circle AoE that leaves behind a black puddle. Stepping in the puddle will cause it to detonate, dealing high damage and inflicting 40s of Heavy, after which it disperses. If the puddle gets detonated, the healer should help cleanse the debuffed player(s) so they can dodge upcoming mechanics.
** Odd pattern: Some adds target random players with line AoEs, while others damage the tank a few times.
* Aetheroplasm: AoE tankbuster. Avoid standing near the tank.
* Death Spin: Point-blank AoE hitting anyone in melee range - move away. Its animation is the boss raising its right claw and holding it high up in the air.
* Allagan Flare: Targets the tank with a proximity raidwide marker.

* Commence Air Strike: Used by Julia. Eight Ceruleum tanks will drop from the sky, four on the outer edge, and four inside. Occasionally, Julia will use Roundhouse to knock the tanks around, with the added effect of dealing damage to and knocking back players in melee range. Regardless of if she uses Roundhouse or not, she will then follow up with Heirsbane targeting a tank to detonate it, dealing damage in a large area around the tank and causing all other tanks in the radius to also detonate.
* Stunning Sweep: Used by Annia. She jumps to a random player, then begins casting. Deals damage to players in melee range.

* Commence Air Strike: Used by Julia. Eight Ceruleum tanks will drop from the sky, four on the outer edge, and four inside. Occasionally, Julia will use Roundhouse to knock the tanks around, with the added effect of dealing damage to and knocking back players in melee range. Regardless of if she uses Roundhouse or not, she will then follow up with Heirsbane targeting a tank to detonate it, dealing damage in a large area around the tank and causing all other tanks in the radius to also detonate.

Arbuda is a massive, four-armed, sword-wielding statue with powerful attacks. Non-tank players should stand at approximately 45 degrees off any of Arbuda's cardinal directions; if you consider his front heading to be 0 degrees, you want to be at 45, 135, 225. or 315. This ensures you'll have plenty of time to reposition to avoid two of Arbuda's main attacks.
*Fourfold Shear: is a slice on the tank, even if you move Arbuda follows you so buff up and get healed.

*Spirit Wave: Light raidwide that also spawns a persistent whirlwind on a random player - usually the ranged DPS or healer. After a short moment, it starts to repeatedly inflict damage and Vulnerability Up stacks on players still in it. Just move out and avoid the area.

*Touch of Slaughter: Targets a random player with a green marker, then leaps at them and sets their HP to a single digit number. The healer should heal them up ASAP, especially as this gets comboed with Hurricane Kick in the next phase, potentially killing the target.

*Spirit Wave: Light raidwide that also spawns a persistent whirlwind on a random player - usually the ranged DPS or healer. After a short moment, it starts to repeatedly inflict damage and Vulnerability Up stacks on players still in it. Just move out and avoid the area.
* Sap Shower: Circular attack targeting all non-Tank players.

* Meteor Rain: Targets the two DPS and the Healer with a large black circle AoE. When the AoE Markers disappear, they are replaced with a ground-targeted proximity AoE at the point each player was standing. This attack leaves behind boulders, which are necessary to evade other attacks.
* Venomous Breath: Cone AoE directed at tank that inflicts poison Poison.

* Deathly Ray (Masks): Faces appear on left or right side and cast lingering line AoEs directly across. The masks on one side will fire first, followed by the opposite side. There is no warning as to which side will fire first, so the healer must keep everyone's HP high enough to potentially survive the first hit.
* Setback: Short cone attack from Unknown's rear. Only used if a player is behind the Unknown and in melee range.
* Clearout: Short cone attack from Unknown's front directed at the Tank.
* Eye of the Cyclone: Ring AoE with the only safe area in melee range of the boss.
* 2,000-mina Swipe: Cone attack directly in front of the boss directed at the Tank.

* Coiling Ivy: Four Painted Ivy adds will appear at the feet of each player and inflict Fetter, thus rooting/binding them in place. The adds need to be targeted and destroyed to remove the debuff. The melee or short-range players can target their own add to break free, while ranged could help free other players from range, after freeing themselves.
* Pendulum: Targeted proximity marker on the tank followed immediately by a proximity marker in the center of the arena.
* Chain Down: Targets a random non-tank player with a crosshair. Shortly after, that player will become Fettered, unable to act. Destroy the Iron Chain to free them.
* Right Round: Untelegraphed melee-ranged AoE that deals minor damage and knocks players back.
